stackfacts/keywords: check my stack for end-of-life versions

description: Check runtimes and OS versions for EOL: is each still supported? Up to 50 product@version pairs, end-of-life date, support status; unknowns get suggestions.

items.description: The versions to check, in order

product.description: endoflife.date product id or alias, e.g. nodejs, python, ubuntu (GET /v1/eol/index lists them)

version.description: Version string, e.g. 18.19.0 (send "3.10" as a string, not a number)

name: stackfacts_eol_check
